Small and micro enterprises each have the same euro limit for turnover and balance sheet totals in the EU classification, i.e. 2 and 10 million euros respectively.
tactical_explanations:
Or instead of And with the money sizes. Turnover and balance sheet totals stand side by side as alternatives: It is enough if one of the two does not exceed the respective limit. Both do not have to be below the same number of euros at the same time. For medium-sized companies, the limits are anyway different (50 against 43 million). If you force one and force one, the rule is inadmissible.

The statement is false.

Only the middle line breaks equality. For medium-sized companies, 50 million euros are in turnover and 43 million euros in balance sheet total. For micro and small companies, the turnover and balance sheet total limit is still identical (2 and 10 million respectively). The deviation is therefore a characteristic of the middle category, not of all size classes. If you expect 50 and 43 everywhere, you misrepresent the middle line.

The statement is true.

Two hundred and fifty heads are sufficient without a financial audit. A large company with 250 employees is present, regardless of how low turnover or balance sheet total are. The person limit is effective without additional condition. The money sizes become decisive only when less than 250 persons are employed. Those who still hope for low sales despite 250 heads, miss the threshold.

The statement is true.

Under 49 heads is necessary, but not sufficient. Even with 30 employees, the company would need additional turnover or balance sheet total within the limits of small companies. If both money sizes tear the large thresholds, it does not count among the small companies despite the low number of persons. "Automatically small because of under 49-- this second condition strikes.

The statement is false.

The same limits apply only below. Micro-enterprises each pay 2 million euros in turnover and balance sheet total, small 10 million euros each; in both lines the two limits are still the same. Only in the middle-sized enterprises do they differ with 50 and 43 million. The rate exactly calls this equality small and small.

The statement is true.

title: EU size classes: thresholds from memory
context: Evaluate the following statements on the thresholds of the EU size classification. A table is not included:
statements: Micro-enterprises may have up to 49 employees, as long as turnover or balance sheet total does not exceed EUR 2 million.
The turnover limit of small companies is 10 million euros, not 50 million euros.
A company with exactly 249 employees is still in the middle category, a company with exactly 250 employees already in the large one.
A company with a balance sheet total of exactly 43 million euros is therefore already one of the large companies.
A company with 10 employees is no longer a micro-enterprise after the number of employees, even if turnover and balance sheet total remain low.
tactical_explanations:
Nine, not forty-nine. The maximum number of persons employed by micro-enterprises is 9; 49 marks the upper limit of small enterprises. If you push 49 into the smallest category, you will skip a whole size class. Between 10 and 49 employees are small, not micro-enterprises. The 2-million money limit does not change this order of persons.

The statement is false.

Ten million are the turnover ceiling of the small ones. Small companies end up with a maximum turnover of 10 million euros; 50 million euros is the turnover limit of the medium-sized enterprises. Anyone who confuses 10 with 50 pushes up an enterprise by an entire category. The number 10 belongs to the small line, the number 50 to the middle line. The sentence divides both correctly.

The statement is true.

One head decides the last step. Up to 249 employees remains the middle category, starting from 250 the big one begins. The border runs without gap directly between these two numbers. There is no intermediate class and no "almost still medium" at 250. The person threshold is sharp here and counts regardless of wishful thinking about turnover.

The statement is true.

Exactly 43 million are still in the middle. 43 million euros are the upper limit of medium-sized enterprises in the balance sheet total, not the start of the large category. Only a balance sheet total of 43 million, together with the other criteria, would open the large class. Anyone "precisely 43", already reads as large, confuses the upper limit with exceeding.

The statement is false.

Ten heads break the micro-limit. The personal limit of the micro-enterprises is 9; ten employees already exceed them. Thus, the micro-category leaves alone because of the number of employees, no matter how low turnover and balance sheet total remain. Whether the company becomes small, medium or large afterwards, the other criteria decide.

The statement is true.

title: Why the legal form matters
context: Evaluate the following statements on the legal form of enterprises:
statements: The legal form is important for the question of who manages the company, who manages the business and who is liable for debt.
It does not matter how the necessary capital is to be raised for the choice of legal form.
Most enterprises in Austria are SMEs, most of which are individual enterprises.
Those who start with savings in small scale need the same legal form as a large industrial enterprise with extensive production capacities.
Anyone who deals with a company should be clear about who is allowed to conclude contracts for the company.
tactical_explanations:
Management, management and liability are not at the side of it. The theory is based on legal regulations that business partners should know who is running, who is running, who is allowed to conclude contracts, who has contributed capital and who is standing up for debt. The legal form answers precisely this bundle of questions, not just the company name on the letter paper. Without this assignment, it would remain unclear whether a signature binds and whose private assets are at stake in open bills. Anyone who treats the legal form as a pure label fails to find the reason why it is important for all the above points and why interested parties look it up in the company's book, provided the company is registered.

The statement is true.

Capital transfer is one of the selection criteria. A legal form according to the theory is suitable according to who is to be founded and who wants to manage, on the other hand according to how the necessary capital is to be raised and to what extent is liable for debt. The assertion that the financing does not matter, cancels the second half of this consideration. A small project with savings and a capital-intensive industrial enterprise is therefore not the same choice.

The statement is false.

SMEs and individual enterprises are the landscape. Most enterprises in Austria are SMEs, and most of them are organised as individual enterprises. Large enterprises with high capital requirements often choose different forms, but this does not change the frequency: the typical Austrian enterprise is small and often a single enterprise. The statement is precisely this weighting, without making any SME a large company with a strong capital.

The statement is true.

A framework does not fit for all. For a person who builds a company in a small context with their savings, a different legal form is suitable than for a large industrial enterprise, which has to build and finance extensive production capacities. Foundation, management, capital and liability are different in both cases. The demand for the same form for both layers contradicts this differentiation.

The statement is false.

The person who deals with companies should know who manages, who manages, who can conclude contracts, who has contributed capital and who is liable. The legal form is important for all these questions, i.e. also for external representation. Without this assignment, it would remain unclear whether a signature binds the company. That is why there are legal provisions on the legal form.

The statement is true.

title: Sole proprietorship and one person
context: Evaluate the following statements on the sole proprietor:
statements: An individual undertaking is characterised by the fact that only one person leads the undertaking, takes decisions and bears the entrepreneurial risk.
A single company requires at least two shareholders.
The independence of the company and the independence of other shareholders in the management of the company is in contrast to the risk borne by the company alone.
Two persons who want to lead and hold an equal share of the company already set up a single company.
Many small businesses are organised as individual enterprises.
tactical_explanations:
One person bundles leadership, decision and risk. This is exactly what the sole proprietorship describes according to theory: only one person leads, takes decisions and bears the entrepreneurial risk. There is no second owner with whom management and liability are shared. Anyone reading several equal heads into this form misses the definition. Focusing on a person is the starting point, not a special case of small shops.

The statement is true.

Two heads do not belong in the individual enterprise. The form is characterized by the fact that only one person leads, decides and bears the risk. At least two partners are the founding prerequisite of the open company, not of the individual enterprise. Anyone who demands the two numbers here confuses the legal forms. A single company is currently being created without further shareholders.

The statement is false.

Independence has a price. According to theory, the independence and independence of other shareholders in corporate management always face the risk that the sole entrepreneur must bear in full. No one has to decide, no one shares unlimited liability with private assets. If the company fails, this often affects the person privately, right up to the private exchange rate. The sentence holds exactly this comparison, instead of confusing independence with a risk-free position or tacitly limiting the liability to the shop inventory.

The statement is true.

The sole company only knows one person who leads, decides and bears the risk. If two persons want to share tasks, financing and liability, the theory is that the way lies over a partnership, for example the open society with at least two partners. This does not create a single company. The two-number is not a detail here, but the change of legal form.

The statement is false.

Small and simple things often coincide. Many small businesses are organized as individual enterprises because they can be set up relatively simply and without minimum capital requirements. The frequency follows from this low threshold, not from a ban on other forms. The sentence makes the typical choice, as stated in theory, without claiming that every small enterprise must be organized in this way.

The statement is true.

title: Unlimited liability in a sole proprietorship
context: A Viennese carpenter runs her business as a single company. Rate the following statements:
statements: The sole proprietor is fully liable for all debts, i.e. not only with its operating assets but also with its private assets.
The sole proprietor's liability shall always be limited to machinery, warehouses and business accounts.
If the sole proprietorship fails, this often means not only the end of the business, but also financial difficulties as a private person.
The failure of self-employment is a common reason for a private bankruptcy.
As soon as the joiner employs two journeymen, they are liable in their place for the operating debts without limitation.
tactical_explanations:
The sole proprietor is fully liable for the entire debts of her company, i.e. liability exists not only with the assets of the company, but also with the assets of the company. Creditors can therefore access housing, savings or other private assets beyond planing banks and warehouses, as far as the right allows. The joiner bears the entrepreneurial risk alone; staff does not change it. Anyone who limits liability to the business circle describes a limited liability that the theory does not attribute to the sole proprietorship.

The statement is true.

Machines and warehouses are not the whole liability pot. Unlimited liability means explicitly: not only operational assets, but also private assets. A limitation to planers, plates and business accounts would protect private assets, although it does not provide this protection for the sole proprietor. If the operation fails, the person remains connected to the debt. The sentence reverses the book rule.

The statement is false.

The company and the person fall together in failure. If the sole proprietorship ends, this often means not only the end for the company, but also financial difficulties for the entrepreneur as a private person, because the liability includes the private property. The carpenter can close the store and still stand with open loans and supplier demands as a private person. This very link describes the theory, instead of failing to think of the company as mere extinction without private consequences.

The statement is true.

Private bankruptcy is not a marginal phenomenon. The failed independence is a common reason for a private bankruptcy, i.e. for a debt settlement procedure with private individuals. This follows from unlimited liability: Operating debts become private over-indebtedness when the company no longer bears. The sentence reproduces the book statement without automatically making any failed operation a court case; often the context is not without exception any case.

The statement is true.

Companies are not liable instead of the owner. Sometimes employees are employed to support, but the unlimited liability remains with the sole proprietor. It leads, decides and bears the risk; employment does not transfer management or liability to the staff. Whoever uses the journeymen as a substitute, confuses the employment contract and ownership.

The statement is false.

title: Formation and capital of a sole proprietorship
context: Evaluate the following statements on the establishment and financing of the individual undertaking:
statements: Many small enterprises are organised as individual enterprises because they can be set up relatively simply and without minimum capital requirements.
For each individual enterprise, the law requires a minimum capital sum without which no creation is possible.
The capital required is usually to be raised by the sole proprietor alone.
If the own resources are not sufficient, the further need for financial resources is in most cases covered by a loan.
An individual undertaking must never obtain missing funds through credit, because only companies may finance externally.
tactical_explanations:
The frequency is explained by the simplicity and lack of minimum capital. Many small companies choose the sole proprietorship because the establishment is relatively simple and there are no minimum capital requirements. The owner does not have to prove any legal starting capital to use the form; the money required usually only applies it, often from savings. If this is not enough, in most cases a loan follows, not a second partner. This facilitates entry into a small framework, but leaves the unlimited liability untouched. The sentence combines the form of organization and the threshold of foundation as it connects.

The statement is true.

There is no legal minimum level here. It is important that individual companies can be established without minimum capital requirements; no legal minimum level applies to the capital. A prescribed sum as a founding requirement would cover precisely this threshold which distinguishes the sole proprietorship from other forms. The claim is therefore wrong.

The statement is false.

The only way to raise capital is by itself. The required capital must normally be raised by the sole proprietor alone, because no other shareholders make contributions to capital. Savings and later earned funds bear the company. The phrase "usually" leaves exceptions open, but does not change the rule: the one person stands for equity.

The statement is true.

Credit closes the gap, not a second owner. If the own funds are not sufficient, the further need for financial resources is in most cases covered by a loan. It is considered a typical way without excluding other sources. Debt capital is added to the equity capital raised alone; it does not transform the sole proprietorship into a company. The statement is made by this frequent financing line.

The statement is true.

The ban on loans for individual companies does not apply. On the contrary, the lack of own funds, in most cases a loan meets the further needs. Debt financing is therefore intended for this form, not reserved for companies. The carpenter can take up a loan and is liable for it without limitation, even privately. The absolute sentence "never credit" contradicts the book rule.

The statement is false.

title: Staff and risk in a sole proprietorship
context: Evaluate the following statements on the division of labor within the individual enterprise:
statements: Often only the sole proprietor or sole proprietor works for the enterprise.
Sometimes a few employees are employed to support.
Those who employ staff no longer bear the entrepreneurial risk themselves, because the employees assume the liability.
The independence of management is always in contrast to the risk that the individual must bear in full on his own.
Several equal holders can run the same single enterprise as one person.
tactical_explanations:
Working alone is the common case. Often only the sole entrepreneur or the sole entrepreneur works for the company; the form does not require a workforce. Leadership, decision and risk are then visibly with the same person. The sentence describes this typical situation without excluding employment of personnel. Smallness and self-activity belong together in theory.

The statement is true.

Support does not change the legal form. Sometimes a few employees are employed to support. They help in the company, but do not become shareholders. One person continues to lead, makes important decisions and bears the entrepreneurial risk. Personnel is help, not co-ownership.

The statement is true.

Employee does not postpone liability. Employees support, but do not assume unlimited liability instead of the owner. The individual entrepreneur bears the risk entirely in full, even if two or three persons are in the shop. Unlimited liability with private assets remains with the owner. The sentence makes an employment relationship falsely a liability assumption.

The statement is false.

Independence and sole risk are a couple. The independence and independence of other shareholders in corporate management is always opposed to the risk that the individual must bear in full. No one has to decide, no one shares unlimited liability with private assets. Staff to support this does not change this burden because employees do not stand up for operating debts instead of the owner. "Always" here is the book formulation, not exaggeration. Anyone who reads independence as a risk-free position separates what binds the presentation together.

The statement is true.

Several female owners fail to define the concept. The sole proprietorship is characterised by the fact that only one person leads, decides and bears the risk. Equal joint ownership is the situation of a partnership with more than one person involved, not of an sole proprietorship. The fiction that several persons are "one person" does not change the legal classification.

The statement is false.

title: Partnerships at a glance
context: Evaluate the following statements on partnerships:
statements: More than one person is involved in a partnership.
The persons involved not only raise capital, they also bear liability for the company's debts.
Whether or not shareholders participate in the company depends on the type of participation.
A partnership is already established when a single owner hires a few employees.
The variants of the open society and limited partnership are distinguished among partnerships.
tactical_explanations:
More than one person is the threshold. More than one person is involved in a partnership; this distinguishes it from a single company with only one leader. Two or more heads raise capital and stand for debt. The head count is not a stylistic means here, but a defining feature. A sole owner does not meet this threshold.

The statement is true.

The same parties are responsible for capital and liability. The persons not only raise the capital for the company, they also bear liability for the debts. Depending on the type of partner, the liability extends to private assets or, with the limited partner, to the contribution. Cooperation is added, but is not the only contribution. The sentence holds the double role: money and debt.

The statement is true.

Cooperation follows the type of shareholder. Depending on the type of shareholder or shareholder involved, the parties also cooperate in the company. In the Open Company, all are entitled and obliged to manage; in the Limited Company, the Complementary works in a comparable manner, the Limited does not, but has control rights and may take into account the books. Capital is both of these forms, liability is also imposed, only to a different extent. The flat-rate formula, which all partnerships always worked with, would therefore be too coarse. The sentence allows precisely this differentiation, without co-operation to make the condition of any capital contribution.

The statement is true.

Employees do not make a company. The sole proprietorship remains a single company, even if a few employees are employed to support it. A partnership requires more than one person involved, i.e. partners, not just personnel. Recruitment does not change the management, capital transfer and liability of the owner into a company. The sentence confuses employment contract and participation.

The statement is false.

Two variants are included in the section. In the case of partnerships, the distinction is made between the Open Society and the Limited Society. The OG only knows one type of shareholder, the KG distinguishes the Complementary and the Limited Society. Other forms do not treat the representation here as a partnership. The sentence represents the breakdown of the books.

The statement is true.

title: General partnership (OG)
context: Two consultants want to establish an Open Society together. Evaluate the following statements:
statements: Open society only knows one type of partner.
At least two shareholders establish the OG.
All shareholders of the OG are entitled to and obliged to manage the company.
A single person can create an OG alone if he or she brings enough capital.
There is no statutory minimum level for the capital of the OG, as is the case with the individual undertaking.
tactical_explanations:
A type of shareholder, not two classes. Open society knows only one type of partner; all are in the same role. There is no type of limited liability here, besides a fully liable type. This is exactly what distinguishes the OG from the limited society with complementary and limited liability. The sentence applies this uniformity.

The statement is true.

The two-numbered person is a prerequisite for founding. At least two shareholders are founding the OG. A person alone does not do this, regardless of capital. The two consultants are therefore in line with the form of their project; one of them alone would have to choose an sole proprietorship or find a second person involved. The rate represents the minimum number.

The statement is true.

Management is the law and duty of all. All shareholders of the OG are entitled and obliged to manage. No one can withdraw from the role of a silent capital investor who only gives money and does not lead; such a restriction to capital without cooperation describes the theory of the limited partnership, not of the OG. The two consultants would therefore both lead the business, not only one of them as employed head. The OG does not know the book description without obligation or vice versa. Liability and management are the same type of shareholder.

The statement is true.

Capital does not replace the second person. The OG is founded by at least two shareholders. A single person, and if his capital is so high, remains an individual enterprise if no one else is involved. Although the legal minimum amount is missing as with the individual enterprise, this does not change the head count. The sole foundation of an OG is not in theory.

The statement is false.

No legal minimum as with the sole proprietorship. Each shareholder and each shareholder participates in the capital, for which however there is no legal minimum level as with the sole proprietorship. The OG is thus not bound to a prescribed start sum. Lack of own funds, as with other partnerships, often remains the bank loan. The rate is coupled with the sole proprietorship at this point.

The statement is true.

title: Joint and several liability in an OG
context: Three shareholders jointly run an Open Society. Evaluate the following statements:
statements: Each shareholder and each shareholder is liable for the total amount of the company's debts with all private assets.
In the OG, each person involved shall be liable only proportionately up to the amount of his own capital contribution.
Solidary liability means that each shareholder and each shareholder is responsible for the total amount of the debt, not just for a fraction.
Anyone who only takes over the purchase in the OG is not liable for debts arising from the sale.
All OG shareholders participate in the capital of the company.
tactical_explanations:
The total amount of private assets and the total amount belong together. Every shareholder and every shareholder of the OG is liable for the total amount of the company's debts with the entire private assets; this is called solidarity liability. Creditors do not have to be satisfied with one third per capita if three persons are involved. You can search for the entire open amount with one person, and the private assets stand for it, not just the deposit. Whoever limits the liability to the business share, describes the limited liability, not the OG.

The statement is true.

The deposit does not cover OG liability. Shared liability up to the capital contribution would be the logic of a liability limitation, as the theory ascribes to the limited liability party. In the OG, each person with the entire private assets is liable for the total amount. Three equal deposits do not make three separate liability pots out of it. The sentence confuses solidarity liability with limited liability for deposits.

The statement is false.

The theory of solidarity depends explicitly on the fact that each shareholder and each shareholder is responsible for the total amount of the debt, with the total of the private assets. A creditor does not have to collect the same fraction in parallel with all three. Internal compensation claims between the shareholders do not change the theory of this external liability. The sentence meets the book definition without denying or embellishing internal compensation.

The statement is true.

The responsibility does not solve the division of tasks. Partners can share tasks and concentrate on purchasing, selling or consulting; all OG shareholders remain entitled to the management and are obliged and liable in solidarity for the total amount. Debts from the sale are the company's debts, not a private special account of the seller. Those who only take over the purchase, nevertheless stand for the whole amount.

The statement is false.

Capital participation is part of the role. Every shareholder and every shareholder participates in the capital of the company; there is no legal minimum level. The OG knows no class that only leads and does not give capital, and no class that only gives money and does not lead. Participation in capital and solidarity liability run in parallel. The rate shall be fixed by the contribution of the capital.

The statement is true.

title: Limited partnership (KG): two types of partners
context: Evaluate the following statements on the limited partnership:
statements: The limited partnership distinguishes between complementary and limited companies.
At least one person is complementary, besides there is at least one person as a commander.
The complementary is comparable with an OG shareholder or an OG shareholder in terms of cooperation, equity participation and liability.
All shareholders of a KG are equally liable only with their capital contribution.
Like the OG, KG only knows one type of shareholder.
tactical_explanations:
Two types bear the KG. The limited partnership distinguishes between two types of shareholders, the complementary and the limited partnership. This is the opposite of the OG, which only knows one kind. Liability, cooperation and capital follow from this distinction: the complementary is the same as the OG-shareholder, the limited partnership is only liable with the deposit and does not cooperate. A uniform status of all parties would cancel this division. The sentence exactly calls the book distinction without formulating the minimum numbers.

The statement is true.

At least one person per type. At least one person is complementary; besides that there is at least one person as a limited-commanditist. If one of the two roles is missing, the described KG is not complete. Two complementary without limited-commanditists would be something different from this form; a sole limited-commanditist without complementary as well. The minimum numbers are thus.

The statement is true.

The complementary reflects the OG role. With regard to the participation in the company, the participation in capital and liability, the complementary is comparable to an OG shareholder. He works with, can contribute capital and is liable without limitation with the private assets for the total amount of the debt, not only with a contribution. KG is storing the limitation of liability with the other type, the limited liability company, which only bears the deposit and does not cooperate. Anyone who reads the complementary as limited liability does not make the comparison and makes two types of shareholders a single one.

The statement is true.

There is no uniform liability for deposits in the KG. Only the limited liability with the own capital contribution; the complementary liability like the OG shareholder, thus unlimited and with the private assets for the total amount. "All only with the limited liability of the complementary would cancel. This is precisely the difference between the two types of shareholder.

The statement is false.

A single way is described by the OG, not the KG. The Open Society only knows one kind of partner; the limited partnership distinguishes complementary and limited. Whoever merges the KG into one class takes the characteristic that puts the theory at the beginning. Therefore, the statement is wrong.

The statement is false.

title: Limited partner: contribution, work, control
context: A limited liability company brings capital into a joint venture and does not cooperate in the company. Evaluate the following statements:
statements: The commander is only liable with his own capital contribution.
The commanding officer does not work in the company.
For this type of shareholder, a limitation of liability is possible.
Committers have control rights and may take a look at the books of society.
The limited liability company manages the business of the KG as well as the complementary and is obliged to do so.
tactical_explanations:
The deposit is the liability limit of this type. At least one person as a limited liability partner is only liable with his own capital contribution, not with all private assets for the total amount of the debt. This distinguishes them from the complementary, which is comparable to an OG-partner unlimited, and from the sole proprietor whose liability also covers the private assets. Creditors can in principle only seek the capital transferred to the limited liability company. The liability limitation is possible for this type of shareholder; it is not waived by the fact that the KG needs a fully liable complementary. The sentence reflects this limitation.

The statement is true.

No cooperation is part of the definition of roles. It is considered to be a person who is liable only with his own capital contribution and does not cooperate in the company. Management is the complementary. The limited partner in the scenario that gives capital and does not cooperate in the company corresponds exactly to this type. The one who makes her co-executive mixes the two types.

The statement is true.

Limitation of liability is the case with this type of company. For the shareholder type limited liability is possible, namely on the own capital contribution. In the complementary and the OG-company, this limitation does not provide for this restriction. The KG exists to take up capital from persons who do not want to fully accept private assets for the total amount. The rate meets this possibility without extending it to the complementary.

The statement is true.

Control replaces management, but does not cancel it as a right. Committers have control rights and may take a look into the books of society. They do not run the business, but do not remain without information. Insight into the books is the counterpart to the lack of cooperation: whoever does not lead the books daily should be able to check what happens to the capital employed. The sentence calls precisely these book rights.

The statement is true.

Management is not the task of the limited liability company. The limited liability company is entitled to the management and is obliged to provide the complementary, comparable to the OG shareholders. The limited liability company does not cooperate in the company; its rights are control and book inspection, not the management. An obligation to manage as in the OG would make the two types one again. The sentence is therefore wrong.

The statement is false.

title: From sole proprietorship to partnership
context: A growing sole proprietorship is reaching the limits of a person. Evaluate the following statements:
statements: Individuals whose size increases to a degree that leads or finances a person too much can be converted into partnerships.
Such a transformation can improve financing and liability and share responsibility for management.
The legal form of an individual undertaking is fixed once and for all and must never be changed.
After conversion into a partnership, only one person is legally entitled to manage the company.
More than one person is involved in the partnership that is created.
tactical_explanations:
Growth can be a blow-up. If the company size increases significantly, so that corporate management and or financing for one person become too much, individual companies can be converted into partnerships. One owner brings more involved persons, rather than continuing alone. The sentence describes precisely this passage provided by the book, not to grow a ban.

The statement is true.

Three motives are mentioned in the presentation. The transformation is to improve the financing possibilities, the liability situation and to divide responsibility for the management. Further heads can contribute capital, bear liability and lead if leadership or financing for one person has become too much. This improves the situation against the sole risk of the sole proprietorship without automatically creating a liability restriction for all: in the OG, liability remains in solidarity and unlimited, limited in the KG only by the limited limited company. The sentence sets the stated objectives without already defining the choice between OG and KG.

The statement is true.

The theory is that individual companies can be converted into partnerships if the scope, management or financing of a person becomes too much. A life-long definition of the first legal form is in contradiction. "Never" is the case here. The sentence is wrong.

The statement is false.

The purpose of the management is precisely to divide responsibility for the management of the company; in the OG all shareholders are entitled to the management and are obliged to do so, in the KG the complementary ones lead. The only compelling condition would be the condition before the conversion. The sentence holds the old form in the new one and is wrong.

The statement is false.

More than one person is the definition after the change. More than one person is involved in a partnership; that is why leadership, financing and liability can be on several shoulders. The transformation consists in making a holder a company with other parties. The sentence follows directly from the definition.

The statement is true.

title: Capital and bank credit for partnerships
context: Evaluate the following statements on the financing of partnerships:
statements: In general, partnerships are limited in terms of the funds provided by the shareholders, because they usually have few shareholders.
These few shareholders are in many cases unable to raise large sums of capital.
Therefore, partnerships are often dependent on bank loans.
Because several people contribute capital, partnerships never need bank loans.
In most cases, the lack of own capital is also covered by a loan.
tactical_explanations:
Few minds limit the deposits. In terms of the funds raised by the shareholders, partnerships are usually limited because they usually have only a few shareholders. OG and KG are not forms with a large number of investors. The restriction follows from the number of persons, not from a legal ban on high deposits. The sentence reflects this rule.

The statement is true.

The few shareholders are in many cases unable to contribute large sums of capital to the company. Savings of two or three people are often not enough for machinery and large capacities, and a minimum legal level does not force them to have a large start-up capital. This is precisely why the next step is to mention the dependence on bank loans. The sentence is the justification of this narrowness, not even the assertion that credit is forbidden or superfluous. Thus, partnerships typically remain narrower in the capital base than with many investors who do not deal with this section.

The statement is true.

Bank credit is the frequent addition. Because the funds transferred are limited, partnerships are therefore often dependent on bank credit financing. Shareholders' equity and credit are side by side, the credit does not replace the legal form. "Often" is the booknuance, not an absolute must. The sentence meets this dependence.

The statement is true.

Several people do not repay the credit requirement. Although two or three parties can raise more than one individual entrepreneur, it is to be noted that partnerships usually have few partners and therefore often remain dependent on bank loans. "Never credit" is the absolute trap. The majority of heads do not change the typical capital narrowness into capital excess.

The statement is false.

Loans are the typical addition to the sole proprietorship. If the own funds are not sufficient, the further needs are usually covered by a loan. Thus, partnerships are in a similar financing line, only that several persons contribute equity and often still need the bank. The rate links both forms by the same debt financing route.

The statement is true.

title: Who is liable, and for how much
context: Compare liability in the sole proprietorship, in the OG and in the KG. Evaluate the following statements:
statements: The sole proprietor is personally and freely liable, i.e. also with the private assets.
The OG shareholders are personally, unlimitedly and each for the total amount of the debt.
The complementary is liable as the OG shareholder.
The commander shall only be liable to the amount of his deposit.
The commander is liable with his entire private assets for the total amount of all debts, just like the complementary.
tactical_explanations:
One person, full liability. The sole proprietor or the sole proprietor is liable for the entire debt, not only with operational assets, but also with private assets. Personally, the natural person is a person, not only a limited circle of operations. Failure can lead to private bankruptcy. The sentence includes exactly this unlimited personal liability.

The statement is true.

Solidarisch und unterhaltig in der OG. Every partner and every partner is liable with all private assets for the total amount of the debts; are called solidarity liability. Personally and unlimitedly the situation remains as with the sole proprietorship, exacerbated by the fact that each person stands up for the entire amount, not only for their share of capital. Three shareholders mean three full liability shoulders outwards; creditors do not have to settle for thirds. The capital contribution is participation, not cover. The sentence matches table and text and separates the OG from the limited-committer, who is liable only until the deposit.

The statement is true.

Complementary equal to OG-Gesellschafter. The Complementary is comparable with an OG-Gesellschafter or an OG-Gesellschafter with regard to cooperation, capital participation and liability; the summary statement explicitly states that the Complementary is as similar as the OG-Gesellschafter. Unlimited, personal, private assets, total amount: this applies to him, not to the limited party. KG splits the roles, but does not cancel the full liability of the complementary.

The statement is true.

The limited liability is only with the own capital contribution, in the table: only up to the amount of his contribution. For this type a limitation of liability is possible. Private assets for the total amount do not require the theory of him. Whoever equates him with the complementary, removes the meaning of the second type of shareholder.

The statement is true.

The complete liability with the entire private assets for the total amount is described as OG-Gesellschafter and Complementär. The limited liability only up to the amount of its contribution and does not cooperate in the company. The KG exists precisely because this limitation is to be possible. The sentence transfers the wrong liability to the wrong type.

The statement is false.

title: Who runs the business
context: Evaluate the following statements on the management in individual companies, OG and KG:
statements: In the sole proprietorship, the sole proprietor or sole proprietor shall conduct the business.
In the OG, the OG shareholders conduct the business, at least two persons.
In the KG, the complementary or complementary is responsible for the business, at least one person.
In the KG, the commander runs the business, while the complementary does not cooperate.
All shareholders of a KG are entitled to and obliged to take over the management, just as in the OG.
tactical_explanations:
The sole proprietorship is characterised by the fact that only one person is running the company and making the decisions. The summary describes the individual entrepreneur as the one who is running the business. employees can support but do not replace this management. The sentence makes the assignment.

The statement is true.

At least two of them lead to the OG. All shareholders are entitled and obliged to manage the OG; the OG is founded by at least two persons. The summary statement says: the OG shareholders, at least two, run the business. A sole managing owner would be the sole proprietor again, even if she employs staff. Capital without a second person does not make an OG out of it. The sentence combines head count and management rights as text and overview combine them.

The statement is true.

Complementary members are the management of the KG. The complementary member is comparable with an OG-company member in terms of cooperation in the company; the table assigns the management to the or the complementary partner, at least one. The limited partnership does not cooperate. At least one fully liable, co-operating person is therefore the management. The sentence follows text and overview.

The statement is true.

The roles are inverted. The commanding officer does not cooperate in the company and does not conduct the business; the complementary officer does both in the manner comparable to the OG-partner. Control rights and book inspection replace the management of the commanding officer, they are not themselves management. The sentence exchanges the two types and is wrong.

The statement is false.

OG rule does not apply to all KG participants. All shareholders are entitled and obliged to the management of the OG because the OG only knows one kind. In the KG, the same management role applies to the complementary partner who works in a comparable manner to the OG shareholder; the limited partnership does not cooperate in the company and has control rights and access to books instead. All as in the OG would make the commander the managing director and mix the liability limitation of this type with a management role that the theory does not attribute to him. The two types of the KG would then be one again. The sentence is wrong.

The statement is false.

title: Raising capital without a statutory minimum
context: Evaluate the following statements on capital raising in individual companies, OG and KG:
statements: The sole proprietor shall raise capital in the sole proprietorship.
In the OG, the OG shareholders raise capital.
In the KG, the limited partnership must make a capital contribution, the complementary can make a capital contribution.
For individual companies, OG and KG, a minimum statutory capital sum is considered as a founding requirement.
Additional equity can be raised by the limited liability by increasing its capital contribution.
tactical_explanations:
A person stands for capital. The capital required usually has to be provided by the sole entrepreneur alone; the overview says the same thing: the sole entrepreneur puts up capital. There is no other partner. If money is missing, credit is usually followed, not a minimum statutory contribution. The rate hits the source of capital.

The statement is true.

All OG participants participate in capital. Every shareholder and every shareholder of the OG participates in capital; the overview assigns the capital transfer to the OG partners. A minimum legal amount is missing as with the individual enterprise. Leadership and capital contribution are with the same kind of partner. The sentence is correct.

The statement is true.

The summary statement states: the complementary can and must distinguish the KG. The limited partnership must provide a capital contribution. The complementary is comparable with the OG-partner's liability and cooperation; his contribution is possible, but not formulated as a must as with the limited partner, whose role is precisely the capital injection with limitation of liability and without cooperation. The limited liability company will later raise additional equity by increasing the contribution, not by managing the company. The rate reflects this asymmetry without making the complementary a limited liability company.

The statement is true.

No minimum statutory amount for these three forms. Individual companies can be set up without minimum capital requirements; the capital of the OG does not apply to a minimum statutory amount as with the sole proprietorship; the overview also does not mention a minimum capital for the KG. A creation ban by a prescribed sum does not belong to this pack of forms of persons. The sentence invents a threshold that denies the representation here.

The statement is false.

Increased participation is the path of the limited-commanditist. Additional equity is raised by the limited-commanditist by increasing the capital contribution; in the complementary, the overview points to the same path as in the OG, i.e. further participation by the shareholders. New large capital markets do not describe the theory for partnerships; few parties remain the rule. The rate applies the planned increase.

The statement is true.

title: Liability, formation and management compared
context: Evaluate the following statements on individual companies, open company and limited partnership:
statements: The OG-Gesellschaftsrin is only liable with the company's contribution; its private assets are always protected against creditors.
At least two people form the Open Society; one person alone is not enough.
The Commander shall be fully liable for the total amount of the debt with all private assets.
The complementary is comparable with an OG shareholder in terms of cooperation, equity participation and liability.
There is no minimum legal level for the capital of individual enterprises and OG.
tactical_explanations:
Private assets are not protected in the OG. Every shareholder and every partner is liable with the entire private assets for the total amount of the debts, solidarity. The company contribution is a share in the capital, not the upper limit of liability; there is no statutory minimum amount, and missing minimum capital does not mean any protection for creditors. Always protected private assets would be the logic of a liability limitation, which the theory ascribes to the limited partnership, not the OG and not the individual enterprise. Creditors can search for the full amount with a shareholder. The rate confuses OG and limited deposit liability.

The statement is false.

The two-number is mandatory. At least two partners establish the OG; the form only knows this one type of party, but not the single establishment. A person who leads, decides and is solely liable remains an individual entrepreneur, even if it makes the same turnover. The second person does not replace the capital amount, especially since there is no statutory minimum amount. The rate holds the founding threshold.

The statement is true.

The limited liability only with the own capital contribution, does not cooperate and has control rights including the inspection of books. Unrestricted with the entire private assets for the total amount do OG shareholders, individual entrepreneurs and complementary. KG separates exactly this burden from the capital-giving type. Anyone who has the limited liability of the commander shall delete the limitation of liability which the theory ascribes to this type.

The statement is false.

The complementary is comparable with the participation in the company, the participation in capital and the liability of an OG-partner. He carries out the work, can contribute capital and is liable as the OG-partner. The commanding officer is also with a contribution, without cooperation, with limited liability. The sentence hits the complementary without making the KG an OG with another name.

The statement is true.

Both forms start without a statutory capital threshold. Individual companies are founded without minimum capital requirements; the capital of the OG does not apply to a statutory minimum level as with the sole proprietorship. This facilitates entry, but leaves the unlimited liability unaffected: missing minimum capital means no limited liability. If you confuse the missing minimum height with creditor protection, you mix two different book statements. The sentence itself to the minimum height is correct.

The statement is true.

title: The idea of a corporation
context: Evaluate the following statements on corporations:
statements: Higher capital amounts can be raised with corporations.
Shareholders of a capital company must always work and manage it themselves in the company.
The law provides for a minimum capital level for the participation in a company.
Capital raising and management may be separate from capital companies.
Companies with limited liability do not have their own legal personality and are not considered legal persons.
tactical_explanations:
Many parties can combine larger amounts. The capital company applies in addition to the partnership, because higher capital amounts are raised more. The shareholders make capital available, are in principle only liable with the person brought in and do not have to take over the management themselves. This combination makes it easier to attract many investors. Whoever claims that large sums are heavier here than with few personally liable persons, reverses the logic of the section.

The statement is true.

The idea of the capital company is that the shareholders make capital available, but not necessarily work in the company and manage it. Management and capital can be separate. The sentence with "stes" and "must" makes a possible role a legal duty and is therefore wrong.

The statement is false.

This form does not apply without a statutory lower limit. It is to be noted that the law provides for a minimum capital level for the capital participation. This distinguishes the capital company from the sole proprietorship and from partnerships, for which no such minimum legal level applies. The share capital of the GmbH and share capital of the AG are concrete manifestations of this rule, not freely invented thresholds. Anyone who denies the minimum capital amount contradicts the core of the capital participation in this section.

The statement is true.

Giving and leading money does not have to coincide in one person. As the shareholders are not necessarily responsible for the management, capital raising and management can be separated from capital companies. A shareholder can invest capital and remain outside; a managing director can lead without being a shareholder. This is precisely the separation that describes the theory as typical, not as a violation of the legal form.

The statement is true.

The company itself is the bearer of rights. Companies have their own legal personality, they are considered legal persons in comparison to natural persons, i.e. people. They can do business, conclude contracts, sue and sue. The claim that there is no legal personality of its own, removes this characteristic and is false.

The statement is false.

title: Legal person and action
context: A Vienna software company is founded as a GmbH. Rate the following statements:
statements: As a legal person, the GmbH can do business, conclude contracts, sue and sue.
The company needs natural persons to act for it.
Only people as natural persons are allowed to enter into contracts; the GmbH cannot do so in its own name.
Shareholders do not necessarily have to be responsible for managing the company.
Own legal personality means that the GmbH can do without the managing director.
tactical_explanations:
The GmbH is itself in the legal proceedings. Companies are considered legal persons: They can do business, conclude contracts, sue and sue. Suppliers, customers and courts have to deal with the company, not automatically with every private name behind the parent deposits. The software company rents offices and buys licenses as a GmbH. Natural persons must act for them, which does not change the ownership of rights and obligations. This very ability follows from the own legal personality which the theory ascribes to the corporations, in contrast to people as natural persons.

The statement is true.

The body remains silent without acting people. The legal person can bear rights, but it needs natural persons who act for it. Managing directors sign, negotiate and represent. Society does not replace people, it needs them as organs. The sentence holds exactly this dependence, instead of thinking the GmbH as completely independent without any acting person.

The statement is true.

The contract does not depend on the private name of each partner. Precisely because the GmbH is a legal person, it concludes contracts in its own name. Natural persons act for them, but the obligation is imposed by the company. The claim that only people are allowed to conclude contracts and the GmbH cannot do so in its own name, cancels the legal personality. The exact opposite is the theory.

The statement is false.

The shareholders make capital available, but are not necessarily entrusted with the management. An employed managing director can manage the software company without holding a regular contribution; one shareholder can invest capital and leave the management to others. The separation of capital transfer and management is expressly possible with corporations.

The statement is true.

Legal personality does not replace any organs. The GmbH is managed by one or more managing directors; as a legal person it needs natural persons who act for it. Those who derive from their own legal personality that there is no longer any need for a management body, confuse the ability to carry contracts with the ability to act without people. The shell alone does not sign.

The statement is false.

title: Share capital of a GmbH
context: Evaluate the following statements on the limited liability company:
statements: For a GmbH, at least one shareholder must be present.
The share capital of a GmbH must be at least 10,000 euros due to legal provisions.
Any parent contribution from a shareholder must be at least 70 euros.
A GmbH may only be established with at least five shareholders.
At least half of the share capital is to be raised in the form of money, the rest can also be a property contribution.
tactical_explanations:
One person is sufficient as a shareholder. It is explicitly stated that there must be at least one shareholder. The GmbH is therefore not a form that necessarily requires several heads. A founder can raise her share capital alone and appoint a managing director who can be her or another person. Those who ask five persons to be established in the law create a threshold that the law does not know.

The statement is true.

Ten thousand euros are the legal lower limit of the share capital. Since 1.1.2024 it is at least 10,000 euros, before that it was 35,000 euros. Both figures are named, the current threshold is the lower. Without this minimum amount the capital participation, which the law provides for the GmbH, is missing. Anyone who treats the 10,000 euros as a non-binding tip misses the legal provision.

The statement is true.

Seventy euros are the lower limit per contribution. Every parent contribution of a shareholder must be at least 70 euros. Several shareholders can therefore raise the share capital in pieces, but not in any cents. The 70 euros are next to the 10,000 euros share capital; both thresholds belong to the GmbH, not to the AG. Under 70 euros per contribution, the statutory minimum amount of the parent contribution would be missed.

The statement is true.

Five heads are not a founding requirement. At least one shareholder or a shareholder is enough. The five number rather reminds of other thresholds or the idea that corporations always need many shareholders. For the GmbH this does not apply. A one-person GmbH is possible according to the theory. The statement is therefore wrong.

The statement is false.

Cash and cash in kind can be shared. At least half of the capital must be raised in the form of money, the rest can also be a property inlay, such as computers or cars. So, with 10,000 euros of capital, at least 5,000 euros must come as money; the remaining 5,000 euros may flow as a matter. If you want to think of the entire share capital exclusively in used equipment without the money share, half of it goes into money. Conversely, the representation explicitly allows you to bring the rest not in cash, but as a matter. This is exactly the mixture that describes the sentence, not a free choice between money or just things without the halves rule.

The statement is true.

title: Management of a GmbH
context: Two carpenters found a workshop GmbH and check who should lead and who should be liable. Rate the following statements:
statements: The GmbH is managed by one or more managing directors.
The managing director must always be a shareholder or shareholder of the GmbH.
A salary is paid to the management and the shareholders receive profit shares for their capital contributions.
The GmbH shareholders only hold liability with their parent contribution.
Additional equity can only be raised at the GmbH by issuing shares.
tactical_explanations:
The management is the management body. The GmbH is managed by one or more managing directors. At least one person in this role is needed; several are permitted. The joiners can order one of them or an external person. Without management there would be no natural person acting for the legal person. The sentence meets exactly this rule of organization, not the shareholders' meeting of the AG.

The statement is true.

The identity of the management and the contribution is voluntary. The managing director can also be a shareholder and then he or she is called a managing partner, but does not have to. An employed managing director without a regular contribution is permitted. "At the same time, it is always a duty and wrong.

The statement is false.

The pay and profit share are different channels. Whoever runs the business receives a salary for it. Whoever has invested capital receives profit shares for the capital contribution. A person can be both and then obtain both; they do not have to. The carpenters who only hold deposits and pay an external line separate the two rivers exactly as it describes. Those who throw salary and profit share into a pot mix organ remuneration and capital gain.

The statement is true.

The parent contribution limits liability. The GmbH shareholders only bear liability with their parent contribution, not unlimited with the private assets as with the sole proprietorship or with OG shareholders. Loans of the workshop access the company assets; the private house of the shareholder beyond that is not automatically liability. The carpenters risk the amount placed in the parent deposit if the legal person does not bear the debt. This restriction gives the form the name Company with limited liability. Whoever here collects unlimited personal liability describes the wrong legal form.

The statement is true.

Shares are the instrument of AG, not the GmbH. Additional equity capital is added to the GmbH by the previous shareholders by increasing their deposits, or an additional shareholder is added. New shares that buy previous or new shareholders are the way of the company. Werkstatt-GmbH cannot increase its share capital by way of shares. The rate confuses the two capital companies.

The statement is false.

title: Liability in a GmbH and an AG
context: Evaluate the following statements on the liability of the investors:
statements: Shareholders are not personally liable for the debts of the AG, they only risk the money they invest in the share purchase.
Limited liability means that GmbH shareholders can never lose the money used for the regular contribution.
The GmbH shareholders only hold liability with their parent contribution.
As the share capital is divided into shares, the shareholders of AG are named shareholders.
Shareholders are fully liable for the total amount of AG's debts with their entire private assets.
tactical_explanations:
Only the share purchase is at stake. Just like the shareholders of GmbH, the shareholders are not personally liable for the AG's debts. They risk the money they invest in the share purchase. If the AG becomes insolvent, they lose this stake; creditors cannot automatically access the housing and savings book of each shareholder. The table says the same thing in the words: Shareholders are liable only with their share capital. Personal, unlimited liability for the total amount of the debt belongs to OG shareholders, not to the AG. Whoever equates both, removes the meaning of the capital company.

The statement is true.

The loss of the stake remains possible. Limited liability protects the remaining private assets, not the amount that has flowed into the GmbH as a parent contribution. If the company fails, this money can be gone. "Never loses the protection direction: the access is limited beyond the deposit, not the risk within the deposit.

The person who mixes both holds limited liability for a guarantee of the capital employed.

Note: Limited means not risk-free; the loss can reach the full parent contribution.

The statement is false.

The table and the flow text indicate the same limit. The GmbH shareholders only bear liability with their parent contribution. This is the capital contribution they have made, not the entire private assets. The creditors of the GmbH adhere to the assets of the legal person. The phrase "only with its parent contribution" is the book-accurate liability rule, not a loose description.

The statement is true.

Share makes the shareholder out of the shareholder. The capital that the shareholders bring in is called share capital and is divided into shares; therefore, the shareholders are called shareholders. Anyone who has bought at least one share is a shareholder of the AG. The name follows from the division of the share capital, not from the mere name of the shareholder. Without this division, there would be no shareholder position in the sense that the theory uses.

The statement is true.

The OG, not the AG, describes in full and solidarity. Shareholders risk buying shares, they are not personally liable for the total amount of the corporate debt with their private assets. The table says: only with their share capital. Whoever transfers the OG liability to the AG mixes the capital company and the partnership. That is exactly what makes the sentence wrong.

The statement is false.

title: Bodies and capital stock of an AG
context: Evaluate the following statements on the public limited company:
statements: The share capital of an AG must be at least 70,000 euros due to legal provisions.
The share capital is divided into shares.
The Board of Management is responsible for the business and represents the company.
The members of the Executive Board are appointed and dismissed by the Supervisory Board.
Large companies that require a lot of capital must not be organised as an AG.
tactical_explanations:
Seventy thousand euros are the lower limit of the share capital. The capital that the shareholders contribute is called share capital and must be at least 70,000 euros due to legal provisions. This is clearly above the 10,000 euros share capital of the GmbH and below the 120,000 euros of the SE. Without this threshold, the statutory capital participation of the AG is missing. Large companies with high capital requirements often choose the form precisely because the share capital can be divided into shares and many investors can pool. Anyone who treats 70,000 euros as a non-binding custom contradicts the statutory provision in theory.

The statement is true.

The share is not a loan. Additional equity can be raised later by issuing new shares that purchase existing or new shareholders. The share is divided into shares, so shareholders are called shareholders. Each share is a share in the share capital, not a loan. The division is the defining feature, not an optional marketing label.

The statement is true.

Management and representation are with the board of directors. He runs the business on his own responsibility and represents the company. This is a different body than the management of the GmbH, but fulfils the same practical role: natural persons act for the legal person. The management board is responsible for its own responsibility, rather than the fact that every shareholder has to sign each contract himself. That is exactly how the AG separates capital and management.

The statement is true.

The appointment comes from the Supervisory Board, not from every shareholder personally in everyday life. The Executive Board members are appointed and dismissed by the Supervisory Board. Thus, the AG has another body between investors and management. Anyone who describes the Executive Board as purely self-appointed or as directly deductible by every small shareholder daily skips the Supervisory Board. The sentence reflects the book rule.

The statement is true.

A lot of capital needs speaks for the AG, not against it. Large companies that require a lot of capital are often organized as AG. The form facilitates large capital sums by many shareholders, who only bear liability with share capital. A ban for large companies is nowhere. The statement reverses the typical choice and is wrong.

The statement is false.

title: Flexible corporation (FlexKap)
context: A start-up checks FlexKapG as a form based on the GmbH. Rate the following statements:
statements: As with the GmbH, a shareholder or a shareholder is sufficient at FlexKapG.
FlexKapG's share capital is also 10,000 euros.
The minimum amount of a parent deposit at FlexKapG is only 1 Euro.
Corporate value participants are entitled to their share of profits and have full voting rights at the same time.
Company value shares are intended to allow for a simple participation of employees.
tactical_explanations:
One head is enough here too. The Flexible Capital Company is based on the GmbH: just as with the GmbH, a shareholder is sufficient. The start-up does not have to collect a shareholder collective. The parallel to the GmbH concerns the shareholder circle, not automatically every detail of the parent contribution. If you ask two people to set up FlexKapG, you transfer the OG rule to the wrong form.

The statement is true.

The share capital is also 10,000 euros. The reference to the GmbH includes this amount. The minimum share capital and the figure of the company's value shares are different, not the share capital sum itself. Those who assign the share capital of 70,000 euros to the FlexKapG mix the forms.

The statement is true.

One euro replaces the seventy-euro threshold of the GmbH. The minimum amount of a parent contribution at FlexKapG is only 1 euro, at the GmbH at least 70 euro. Small pieces facilitate finer investments. The share capital remains 10,000 euro; only the smallest permissible contribution decreases. Anyone who demands 70 euros for FlexKapG also ignores this difference, which the theory calls essential in addition to the company's shares in value.

The statement is true.

Profit yes, vote no. Corporate value participants have a right to their share of profits, but they have no voting rights. "At the same time, full voting rights are removed from the second half of the book rule. Especially the missing vote distinguishes this special form of share capital from the traditional form of shareholder formation.

If you pack both, you do not describe any corporate value participation.

Note: Profit share without voting rights is the point of employee participation, not a hidden full-party partnership.

The statement is false.

Employee participation is the purpose of the special form. A significant difference to the GmbH is that FlexKapG provides for company value shares that are a special form of share capital and are intended to allow for a simple participation of employees. The start-up can allow employees to participate in the company's value without the same cut in voting rights as with a full share: profit share yes, voting rights no. Share capital 10,000 euros and one-euro share contribution remain in addition. The sentence meets precisely this intention of simple participation, not a hidden renaming of the classic GmbH company creation.

The statement is true.

title: European Company (SE)
context: Evaluate the following statements on Societas Europaea:
statements: The European Company is also called European Company or Societas Europaea (SE).
The legal framework for the SE is always the same, regardless of the Member State in which the SE is established in the EU or the EEA.
The minimum capital of the SE is 120,000 euros.
The SE is the legal form required for any small Austrian industry without establishment in another State.
The Strabag is organized as an SE, for example.
tactical_explanations:
Three names refer to the same variant of the public limited company. The European company is also called European Company or Societas Europaea (SE). It is a variant of the AG, not the GmbH and not the cooperative. The abbreviation SE appears in large, cross-border companies. Anyone who confuses the SE with the SCE, the European cooperative, is using the wrong Latin name.

The statement is true.

The SE is a possible legal form for public limited liability companies in the European Union and the European Economic Area. The legal framework is always the same, regardless of the Member State in which the SE is established in the EU or the EEA. This is exactly what makes the form interesting for companies with branches in several countries, because they do not need a completely different stock law than a shell in every country. The Strabag example logic fits in with this: large, cross-border activity. Anyone who claims that every country of residence is inventing a completely different SE right contradicts this equality, which the theory calls preference.

The statement is true.

The minimum capital is 120,000 euros, in the table next to the 70,000 euros of the AG. This is above GmbH and national AG. Without this amount the statutory capital participation of the SE is missing. Whoever uses 10,000 or 70,000 euros as a minimum SE, confuses the forms.

The statement is true.

The SE is of particular interest to companies with branches in several EU or EEA countries. It is a possible form, not a requirement for any small Austrian industry. In theory, a one-person trade without a foreign reference is thought of as a typical individual enterprise or, at most, as a GmbH, not as an SE with a value of 120,000 euros.

The statement is false.

Strabag shows SE in practice. The company is organized as Societas Europaea and illustrates the European capital company in a large company with an international relationship. The form is not typical for a locally isolated small business without cross-border requirements. The example shows that the SE is real in Austria. The choice of legal form follows here size and international orientation.

The statement is true.

title: Purpose of a cooperative
context: Several gardening companies want to use machines together and shop. Rate the following statements:
statements: Cooperatives are associations of at least two natural and/or legal persons.
The aim is to promote the acquisition and economy of its members.
The focus is on achieving profits, not the common economy.
Common benefits of production facilities and equipment, as well as joint purchasing and/or distribution are typical forms of common management.
The legal form is the registered cooperative (e. Gen.) in Austria.
tactical_explanations:
Two are the lower limit, people and companies are allowed. Cooperatives are associations of at least two natural and/or legal persons. A single nursery alone is not a cooperative; GmbHs can be a member alongside persons. The two-number distinguishes the form from the one-person GmbH. If you start a cooperative with just one member, you're going to fall short of the book rule.

The statement is true.

The purpose of the promotion of members is not to create a secondary set. The aim is to promote the acquisition and economy of their members. The gardening plants are closed so that each of them is economically better, for example through common machines or joint purchasing. The legal form is used to establish cooperatives for the acquisition and economic development. The motto What one does not achieve, many create the same point: common size instead of isolated profit maximization of the shell. Whoever narrows the purpose to the profit of the legal person as an end in itself misses this orientation to the members, which puts the theory at the beginning.

The statement is true.

The main focus is not on winnings, but on the common economy. The motto is: what one does not create, many create. Profits can be reinvested or paid as refunds, but they do not define the form. The sentence turns the foreground and the background and is wrong.

The statement is false.

Synergies are created by sharing and bundling. The common benefits of production facilities and equipment and/or joint purchasing and/or distribution are the methods mentioned in theory. Together, you can achieve different size ratios. The gardening plants can share a pond excavator or order plants together. These examples are the very purpose of the membership promotion, without any cooperative having to go all three ways at once.

The statement is true.

e. Gen. is the Austrian name. The legal form itself is registered in Austria and serves for the establishment of profit and economic cooperatives. The European counterpart is the Societas Cooperative Europaea (SCE). Anyone who confuses the Austrian form with the SE of the public limited companies, takes the wrong European variant. The sentence is the national name.

The statement is true.

title: Liability, votes and bodies of a cooperative
context: Evaluate the following statements on capital, liability and will-building in the cooperative:
statements: The cooperative does not require a minimum capital.
If a cooperative share is 100 euros, the cooperative is usually liable for another 100 euros, the possible loss is maximum 200 euros.
The highest organ of the cooperative is the general meeting.
In the case of the right of the head, each person has one vote regardless of his or her share of the cooperative capital.
The statutes of a cooperative must never replace the right to vote by a different arrangement.
tactical_explanations:

The statement is false.

Time gaps create short-term demand. Deliveries often have to be paid before sales proceeds are received. In addition to the long-term demand for investment funds, this creates a short-term financial requirement for the ongoing cycle. Banks and suppliers can close this gap, for example via payment targets. The sentence describes precisely this asymmetry between disbursement to suppliers and subsequent customer payment, not a second foundation.

The statement is true.

Turnover fills the cash register, but does not cancel the demand. After the start of the activity, funds are again available through sales proceeds, but often suppliers have to be paid earlier, and investments remain to be financed additionally. The claim that any further need is automatically eliminated confuses the inflow of revenue with a complete coverage of all future payments. Long-term purchases and recurring current payments remain financing events. The text of the teaching juxtaposes both, instead of making turnover the all-purpose solution.

The statement is false.

title: Equity and contributions in kind
context: Evaluate the following statements on equity:
statements: Capital that brings founders, founders or shareholders into the company is considered equity.
Capital is limited to money; non-material contributions do not increase capital.
If founders bring in money and a small van and two PCs, these deposits will also increase equity.
Equity must normally be fully repaid to donors after a short period of time.
Equity is available to the company in the long term, usually indefinitely.
tactical_explanations:
